# Clarity Chat Components

> Clarity Chat is a production-ready React component library for building AI chat interfaces with 200+ components, 95+ hooks, streaming support, RAG, memory management, and enterprise features. Built with TypeScript, React 19, and Tailwind CSS.

Clarity Chat provides everything you need to build AI chat applications - from simple chatbots to enterprise-grade conversational AI with memory, RAG, tool calling, and multi-tenancy support.

---

## Packages

### @clarity-chat/react
Main React component library with all components and hooks.

### @clarity-chat/memory
- clarityMemory - Zero-config memory factory
- MemoryService - Core memory service
- ConsentManager - GDPR/CCPA compliance
- AuditLogger - Audit logging
- LLMSummarizer - LLM-based summarization
- DecayManager - Memory decay/forgetting

### @clarity-chat/token-optimization
- AccurateTokenCounter - Accurate token counting
- ModelRouter - Model routing
- TieredCache - Multi-tier caching
- LLMLinguaCompressor - LLMLingua compression
- ProviderCachingFormatter - Provider-native caching
- QualityGate - Quality validation
- CostAwareOptimizer - Cost optimization

## AI-Optimized APIs

Programmatic access to Clarity Chat documentation for AI systems and RAG applications:

- /api/ai/components - JSON endpoint with all component documentation
- /api/ai/hooks - JSON endpoint with all hook documentation
- /api/ai/search - Full-text search across all documentation
- /api/ai/health - API health and status monitoring
- /openapi.json - Full OpenAPI 3.0 specification

### Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server

Available MCP tools for Claude Code and other AI tools:
- list_components - List all components with basic info
- get_component - Get detailed component documentation
- list_hooks - List all hooks with basic info
- get_hook - Get detailed hook documentation
- search_docs - Search all documentation
- health_check - Check API health

MCP Server Configuration:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "clarity-chat": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["tsx", "apps/streamlined-docs/mcp-server/index.ts"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Library Information

- **Version**: 2.0.0
- **License**: MIT
- **Repository**: https://github.com/clarity-ai/clarity-chat-components
- **Documentation**: https://clarity-chat.dev
- **NPM Package**: @clarity-chat/react
- **React Version**: 18+ / 19
- **TypeScript Version**: 5.0+
- **Node.js Version**: 18+

---

## Installation

```bash
# npm
npm install @clarity-chat/react

# pnpm
pnpm add @clarity-chat/react

# yarn
yarn add @clarity-chat/react
```

**Peer Dependencies:**
- React 18+ or React 19
- Tailwind CSS 3.4+

**Optional Packages:**
```bash
npm install @clarity-chat/memory @clarity-chat/token-optimization
```

---

## Quick Start Example

```tsx
import { ClarityChatApp } from '@clarity-chat/react'

function App() {
  return <ClarityChatApp api="/api/chat" />
}
```

With memory enabled:
```tsx
<ClarityChatApp
  api="/api/chat"
  features={{ memory: true }}
/>
```

Enterprise preset:
```tsx
<ClarityChatApp
  api="/api/chat"
  preset="enterprise"
/>
```
